scope: Additive standard Home Village defensive targetability contract for the two flying Heroes. Banner patrol, assignment and defensive timing remain outside this narrow contract.

sources.title: Pinned Minion Prince and Dragon Duke descriptions
sources.limitations: The descriptions define targetability only. They do not define Hero Banner assignment, patrol, target acquisition or timing.

defensive_ranged_or_air_only.note: The pinned source says that when defending, the Minion Prince can only be attacked by ranged and air units.

defensive_air_targeting_only.note: The pinned source says that when defending, the Dragon Duke can only be attacked by air-targeting enemies.

conclusion: Core applies the two source-declared restrictions when these Heroes are materialized as defenders. It does not infer any Banner behavior.
